name: Internal Linking Engine
description: Automatic organic internal linking + one conversion CTA block per article, for every connected site. Builds a lightweight content index, proposes language-isolated relevant link targets, drafts anchor placements and a CTA with a strict preview -> apply -> rollback diff -- never a silent content rewrite.

tools.name: enable_site
tools.description: Turn on Internal Linking Engine for one site already known to Sites Registry. Creates the site's settings row in review_first mode by default -- no content is touched until a plan is previewed and explicitly applied.

site_id.description: Site id/domain from Sites Registry to enable Internal Linking Engine for.
site_id.title: Site Id

domain.description: Site domain, for display; defaults to site_id if left blank.
domain.title: Domain

max_links_per_post.description: Max internal links this engine may add per article (2-5 recommended).
max_links_per_post.title: Max Links Per Post

languages.description: Explicit language codes to isolate (e.g. ['ru','ro']). Leave empty to auto-detect per article.
languages.title: Languages

return_schema.description:
One site's Internal Linking Engine configuration. site_id matches the
Sites Registry id/domain so both apps agree on identity without a
translation table.
return_schema.title: SiteSettings

tools.description: Update an existing site's Internal Linking Engine settings (mode, limits, CTA targets, exclusions, languages). Only given fields change.

site_id.description: Site id to update settings for.
site_id.title: Site Id

enabled.title: Enabled

mode.description: review_first or full_auto. Blank keeps current value.
mode.title: Mode

full_auto_threshold.description: Confirmed applies required before full_auto becomes eligible.
full_auto_threshold.title: Full Auto Threshold

tools.name: index_posts
tools.description: Cache metadata for a batch of posts already fetched via wordpress-hub, so the Relevance Engine can score them without re-fetching. Call this once per post before get_relevant_targets/preview_internal_links can use it as a candidate or source.

site_id.description: Site id these posts belong to.
site_id.title: Site Id

posts.description: Post metadata already fetched via wordpress-hub, one dict per post: post_id, title, slug, url, post_type, categories, tags, product_type, lang, excerpt, outbound_link_urls.
posts.title: Posts

IndexedPost.description:
One article/page's cached metadata for relevance scoring. Populated
from data Webbee already fetched via wordpress-hub (list_posts/
get_post_content/get_post_meta/extract_links) and passed in -- this app
never fetches it itself (see app.py docstring).
IndexedPost.title: IndexedPost

tools.name: get_site_index_status
tools.description: One-glance index health for a site: how many posts indexed, by language, and when last indexed.

site_id.description: Site id to read index status for.
site_id.title: Site Id

IndexedPost.description:
One article/page's cached metadata for relevance scoring. Populated
from data Webbee already fetched via wordpress-hub (list_posts/
get_post_content/get_post_meta/extract_links) and passed in -- this app
never fetches it itself (see app.py docstring).
IndexedPost.title: IndexedPost

tools.name: get_relevant_targets
tools.description: Find the top-N internal-link targets for one already-indexed source post, using deterministic metadata + term-overlap scoring (categories/tags/product_type/title). Language isolation is a hard filter -- a candidate whose lang differs from the source post's lang is never returned, even if it scores highest (the climtec.md RU/RO lesson). Excluded URLs from the site's settings are also dropped before scoring.

source_post_id.description: Post id (must already be indexed) to find relevant link targets for.
source_post_id.title: Source Post Id

RelevanceMatch.description: One scored candidate link target for a source post.
RelevanceMatch.title: RelevanceMatch

tools.name: preview_internal_links
tools.description: Build a preview linking+CTA plan for a site -- NEVER writes anything. Takes raw content Webbee already fetched via wordpress-hub.get_post_content, and (optionally) anchor/CTA insertions Webbee already drafted via an LLM pass, and validates every proposed insertion's find_exact_substring occurs EXACTLY ONCE in that post's current raw content -- any insertion that doesn't is dropped, never guessed. Returns a plan_id; nothing is applied until apply_internal_links is called after Webbee has actually written each surviving diff via wordpress-hub.replace_post_content_text.

site_id.description: Site id to build a linking+CTA plan for.
site_id.title: Site Id

post_ids.description: Optional explicit post ids to limit the plan to; empty scans every indexed post for this site.
post_ids.title: Post Ids

posts_content.description: Raw content + state tokens Webbee already fetched via wordpress-hub.get_post_content, one dict per post: {post_id, title, url, lang, raw_content, expected_state_token}. This app never fetches content itself (see app.py docstring).
posts_content.title: Posts Content

proposed_insertions.description: Optional: anchor/CTA insertions Webbee already drafted via an LLM pass per post, keyed by post_id: [{post_id, link_suggestions: [...], cta_suggestion: {...}}]. If omitted, this app only returns relevance-scored candidate targets per post without drafted anchor text (a lighter, metadata-only preview) -- Webbee can then draft insertions and call preview again to attach them.
proposed_insertions.title: Proposed Insertions

return_schema.description:
One scan/preview run for a site -- the unit preview_internal_links
creates and apply_internal_links/reject_linking_plan/rollback_linking_run
transition through PLAN_STATUS_CHOICES.
return_schema.title: LinkingPlan

LinkingPlan.title: LinkingPlan

tools.name: apply_internal_links
tools.description: Record that a pending_review plan's diffs were actually written to the site -- call this ONLY AFTER Webbee has already called wordpress-hub.replace_post_content_text for each surviving insertion in the plan (using expected_state_token per post for safety). This function does not write to any site itself; it only transitions the plan's own status and increments the site's confirmed_applies_count toward its full_auto threshold.

plan_id.description: Linking plan id to mark as applied, AFTER Webbee has actually written each diff via wordpress-hub.replace_post_content_text.
plan_id.title: Plan Id

applied_post_ids.description: Which post ids from the plan were actually written successfully; partial application is recorded honestly (not all-or-nothing).
applied_post_ids.title: Applied Post Ids

return_schema.description:
One scan/preview run for a site -- the unit preview_internal_links
creates and apply_internal_links/reject_linking_plan/rollback_linking_run
transition through PLAN_STATUS_CHOICES.
return_schema.title: LinkingPlan

tools.name: apply_internal_links_batch
tools.description: Record several explicitly named pending_review plans as applied in one batch -- call ONLY AFTER Webbee has written every exact diff for every listed plan via wordpress-hub.replace_post_content_text. This never writes site content itself and never selects plans implicitly: the caller must list every plan_id. The batch validates all plans before changing any audit status.

BatchApplyPlanItem.description: One reviewed plan included in a single explicit batch confirmation.

plan_id.description: Pending-review linking plan id to record as applied.
plan_id.title: Plan Id

applied_post_ids.description: Post ids from this plan whose diffs Webbee actually wrote successfully.
applied_post_ids.title: Applied Post Ids

BatchApplyPlanItem.title: BatchApplyPlanItem

params_schema.description: Explicit batch confirmation. No pending plan is selected implicitly.

plans.description: Explicit reviewed plans to mark as applied after their exact WordPress diffs were written. Every id must still be pending_review; the operation is all-or-nothing for audit safety.
plans.title: Plans

params_schema.title: ApplyInternalLinksBatchParams

LinkingPlan.description:
One scan/preview run for a site -- the unit preview_internal_links
creates and apply_internal_links/reject_linking_plan/rollback_linking_run
transition through PLAN_STATUS_CHOICES.
LinkingPlan.title: LinkingPlan

tools.name: reject_linking_plan
tools.description: Reject a pending_review plan without applying it. Nothing was ever written, so this is purely a status change.

plan_id.description: Linking plan id to reject without applying.
plan_id.title: Plan Id

return_schema.description:
One scan/preview run for a site -- the unit preview_internal_links
creates and apply_internal_links/reject_linking_plan/rollback_linking_run
transition through PLAN_STATUS_CHOICES.
return_schema.title: LinkingPlan

tools.name: rollback_linking_run
tools.description: Roll back an already-applied plan: returns the original find/replace pairs (the inserted anchor/CTA text as 'find', the pre-insertion original snippet as 'replace') for Webbee to write back via wordpress-hub.replace_post_content_text, restoring each post's content. This function does not write to any site itself -- it only returns the rollback instructions and transitions the plan's own status once Webbee confirms.

plan_id.description: Applied plan id to roll back -- returns the original find/replace pairs for Webbee to write back via wordpress-hub.replace_post_content_text.
plan_id.title: Plan Id

return_schema.description:
One scan/preview run for a site -- the unit preview_internal_links
creates and apply_internal_links/reject_linking_plan/rollback_linking_run
transition through PLAN_STATUS_CHOICES.
return_schema.title: LinkingPlan
